text: This is an invoice from Northwind Components Ltd for 10,000.00 $ covering 100 motor controller board v2 units. A review found that only 60 units were received, the currency differed from the purchase order, and the vendor name could not be confirmed, though 21 checks passed. We are paying 6,000.00 $ now for what was received and holding 4,000.00 $ until the rest arrives.
